explication: Antra is a desktop music-library builder: users submit music links, fetch or resolve track metadata, acquire audio from available sources, then tag and organize files in a local library. The repository contains a Svelte/Wails desktop application alongside a Python service and download engine. The graph preserves the documented provider, format, lyrics, artwork, and library-management capabilities. Some backend and adapter implementations were not excerpted, so uncertain internal connections are omitted; documented workflow links cite the README.
